content.title: On a university website?
content.subtitle: Not the brochure. The course page matters most.

steps.title: Eligibility
steps.detail: Which degree, what marks and what background they need. Read this first, the rest later.

steps.title: English test requirement
steps.detail: Which test is accepted and the minimum score. It can differ for each course.

steps.title: Deadlines
steps.detail: Application, scholarship and deposit dates are often different. Put all three in your calendar.
steps.tip: Check the time zone too. Their night can be our morning.

steps.title: Course modules
steps.detail: Don't go by the name. Look at which subjects are actually taught.

steps.title: Fees and funding page
steps.detail: Other costs are usually listed next to tuition. The scholarships link is often there too.
steps.tip: Compare fees on Course Finder first.

caption:
Lost on university websites? Check these 5 things on the course page first 👇

1. Eligibility
2. English test requirement
3. Deadlines
4. Course modules
5. Fees and funding

Save this 📌 and send it to a friend who needs it.
